# AVAS (Ayala Virtual Assistance Services)

> AVAS is a marketing execution team in Manila, Philippines, founded in 2021 in Quezon City by Gwen Ayala. One team runs strategy, content, funnels, ads and ops, and shows you what it produced. It serves brands in the United States, Australia and the Philippines.

- Site: https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/
- Founder: Gwen Ayala, Founder and Marketing Strategist. Co-founder and COO: Jamz Jamorol.
- Services (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/services/): Growth Roadmaps, Brand Positioning, Campaign Planning, Content Creation, Social Media, Ad Management, Email Marketing, Funnels & CRM, Admin Support, SEO, GEO, AIO.
- Pricing (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/pricing/): published prices, a diagnostic first, then monthly retainers; anything else is a quote.
- Work (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/work/): the current clients, what AVAS runs for them and what it produced.
- Team (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/team/) and About (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/about/): the people behind the work.
- How it works (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/how/): from the first call to your private link and the report of what shipped.
- Book a call (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/book/): thirty minutes, founder to founder.
- Contact: info@ayalavirtualassistance.com
- Sister company: JTL Growth (https://jtlgrowth.com/) runs AI and automation builds. The two companies split by discipline and refer clients both ways.

## Robots & Coffee

Robots & Coffee (https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/robots-and-coffee/) is a series of two-day, hands-on AI workshops in Manila run by Gwen Ayala and Jamz Jamorol. Attendees build AI employees on their own real business in the room: a lead finder, a DM answerer, a content writer, an admin assistant and a second brain. Held at Novel Hotel BGC, doors 9:30 AM, done at 7 PM. No prices are listed on the page; the waitlist is free.

- Batch 1: Aug 22 to 23, 2026, Novel Hotel BGC (done)
- Batch 2: Sept 19 to 20, Novel Hotel BGC (done)
- Waitlist: https://ayalavirtualassistance.site/ai-workshop-waitlist/
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61592292412856 · https://www.instagram.com/robots_and_coffee/
